hoghunter.notes: Hog Hunter iPhone companion for the macOS menu bar utility.  Apple ID 6816633156, team CC8UTF7ATG, ASC SKU hoghunter-ios.  The Xcode project is generated from project.yml (xcodegen at the repo root) and is not committed.  Version numbering (owner directive 2026-10-29):  the marketing version is the fixed 0.1.0 and the build is one shared merge-timestamp value per release, max(S, M + 1), where S is the merge commit's Chicago date as YYYYMMDDHHMM and M is the highest first build component across iOS, the paired macOS app and the Sparkle feed floor;  the CI plan-build job computes it once and every ship job reuses it.
